test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A and B start running simultaneously, around a circular track of 1200 m, in the same direction, at a speed of 8 m/s and 12 m/s, respectively. A and B will meet at the starting point for the first time after:
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the circular track = 1200 m

Speed of A = 8 m/s

Speed of B = 12 m/s

**Formula Used:**

Time taken to meet at the starting point = Length of the track / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed when running in the same direction = 12 m/s - 8 m/s

Relative speed = 4 m/s

Time taken to meet at the starting point

⇒ Time = Length of the track / Relative speed

⇒ Time = 1200 m / 4 m/s

⇒ Time = 300 s

**A and B will meet at the starting point for the first time after 300 seconds.**
